authority: Founder-approved complete prescription content; exact canonical definitions/versions/events and physical publication remain pending.

policies.approved_variants: Exercise variant content is approved 2026-10-25: main front-rack reverse lunge uses a BARBELL front rack; cable Pallof press uses SPLIT STANCE. Preparation ramps remain separate from working sets. No RDL/lunge load derives from a squat benchmark.
policies.audience: Developing or advanced athletes able to run continuously for 45 minutes.
policies.benchmarks: 10 km run time, 2 km row time, back squat 5RM total external load, strict OHP 5RM total external load, maximum strict pull-ups (zero valid). Own test date and source/type required; no freshness cutoff or automatic latest/best selection.
policies.capture: Prescribed targets, advisory guidance and actual performance are separate. Athletes may record actual load in existing supported actual-load fields or optional notes; no new mandatory result, race attestation or division lookup follows from advisory text.
policies.core_progression: Optional W5 carry load, longer plank lever or Pallof resistance only with position maintained and athlete choice. No compulsory increase. W4 carry and Pallof lighter.
policies.core_rest: 45–60 seconds as needed; no compulsory recovery at each side change is prescribed.
policies.duration: Generally 60–90 minutes; do not add filler. Preparation and cooldown are additional to main running.
policies.equipment: Approved variants use barbell/rack (including front-rack reverse lunge), dumbbells/incline bench, pull-up bar, cable station (including split-stance Pallof), carry space, rower, fan bike, SkiErg, wall ball/target, kettlebell and preparation bands. Canonical identity/version authority and marketing/prerequisite copy are separate.
policies.finisher_load: Effort/technique selected, no fixed kilograms. Rep work leaves recovery inside the minute; record athlete scaling using existing supported logging. “Use your race weight” in these circuits is advisory only: no exact load, target height, verified race standard or division lookup is prescribed. Explicit prescriptions and formal assessments retain their own requirements.
policies.history: Explicit benchmark replacement acceptance affects future unstarted sessions only; started/completed prescriptions immutable. Actuals separate. No inferred loads for RDL/lunge/other press/pull-ups.
policies.periodisation: W1–3 build; W4 reduces gym/finisher demand with modest running reduction; W5–7 build; W8 consolidates.
policies.personalisation: Only quality running, dedicated rowing and back squat have approved numeric derivation. Pace=10 km seconds/10; 4–5 min x1.00–1.05, 6–7 min x1.02–1.07, 10 min x1.03–1.08. Row split=2 km seconds/4, +10–15 seconds for 2-min reps, +12–18 for 3-min reps; W4 +18–23, W8 +15–20. Squat=5RM x authored basis points/10000, nearest configured total barbell increment, ties down. No guessed increment. Missing means unavailable, plus authored effort only; no invented row fallback.
policies.post_base: No compulsory post-Base assessment; representative benchmarks needed before next plan. Test Week is a separate unauthored programme, never inserted here.
policies.purpose: Build aerobic capacity, compound strength, shoulders/pulling, grip and bracing before specific HYROX preparation. Base is purpose, not beginner status.
policies.running_effort: Easy/long conversational, RPE about 3–4. Quality RPE about 7, repeatable. Choose within duration windows by feel/recovery; no level bands or invented HR zones.
policies.schedule: Eight weeks; Mon Gym A, Tue easy run, Wed Gym B, Thu quality run, Fri Gym C, Sat long run, Sun rest. One session/day; six/week.
policies.strength_rest: Back squat working sets: 150–180 seconds throughout; warm-up sets separate. RDL/reverse lunge: 120–180 seconds. Upper pair A: 90–120 seconds after pair; B/C: 90 seconds.
policies.substitution: Running intended for all three aerobic sessions. Bike substitution only under verified existing rules plus athlete acceptance, preserving duration/effort, never running pace. Approved variant content does not grant new substitution or canonical mapping authority.
policies.upper_progression: Build repetitions within ranges before suggesting load increases; athlete accepts. No OHP load inference from its benchmark. No automatic progression on completion.

gym_a.execution_note: Set up the next station during recovery. Budget includes ramps and light pair rehearsal; if not ready, extend preparation and record that fact rather than rush or cut approved working sets. Full-session timing is an estimate, not a fixed sum or a new tempo.
gym_a.ramp_up: After the circuit, perform 2–3 short squat ramp sets: empty bar or very light × 8; add load × 5; if useful, a final heavier × 2–3. Work towards, never above, the planned first working load; each ramp feels comfortable with several reps spare. Use about 30–60 s to change load/recover, then 60–90 s before the first working set. If the working load is light, omit the unnecessary heavier ramp. Working sets still rest 150–180 s.

gym_b.execution_note: Set up the next station during recovery. Budget includes ramps and light pair rehearsal; if not ready, extend preparation and record that fact rather than rush or cut approved working sets. Full-session timing is an estimate, not a fixed sum or a new tempo.
gym_b.ramp_up: Perform two RDL ramp sets: very light × 8, then a moderate load × 5, both comfortably short of fatigue; rest about 30–60 s while changing load. Choose by feel and hinge control, not a squat benchmark. Before the first press/row pair, take one brief easy rehearsal of each if needed; this is preparation, not another working pair.

gym_c.execution_note: Set up the next station during recovery. Budget includes ramps and light pair rehearsal; if not ready, extend preparation and record that fact rather than rush or cut approved working sets. Full-session timing is an estimate, not a fixed sum or a new tempo.
gym_c.ramp_up: Perform two front-rack reverse-lunge ramp sets: a light barbell front rack × 4 per leg, then a moderate barbell front rack × 2 per leg, with about 30–60 s to recover/change load. Keep balance and the front rack comfortable. Choose loads by feel, never a squat benchmark. Before the first press/row pair, take one brief easy rehearsal if needed.

quality.dynamic_preparation: One relaxed circuit: 8 bodyweight squats, 6 bodyweight reverse lunges per leg, 8 unloaded hip hinges. Keep moving and use the remainder of two minutes for easy walking/jogging; no stretching into discomfort.
